caption:
Can you pass the turn test? 🏌️‍♂️

Sit tall on a chair, club across your shoulders, and turn each way.
✅ 2 points: 45° each way with your hips still
🟡 1 point: you only get there on one side
❌ 0 points: your hips move or you can't reach 45°

Most golfers who score a 0 or 1 make up for it with their low back. Comment your score 👇 Tomorrow we'll post 3 fixes.

Any pain during the test? Stop and get it checked.
